notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Donnie & April, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Donnie & April's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Donnie & April from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
